entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about an order I placed. I need to return a pair of road cycling shoes.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you please provide me with your order number?
Sure, it's VF-881-92B4. I got them about three and a half weeks ago.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 27 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's a preference. I installed my cleats and went for one ride, but they gave me terrible blisters. The fit just isn't right for my feet.

I'm very sorry to hear that; getting blisters is no fun. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, it looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

That's good to hear. I appreciate that. Now, since I did have to go through the hassle of setting up the cleats, and now I have to remove them and ship these back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? I'd like to try a different model from you.

I understand the inconvenience. While our system doesn't allow me to generate a discount code for a standard return, I can ensure the return shipping is completely free for you. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your full refund will be issued to the original payment method.
Okay, free return shipping is fair. I can work with that. Will the instructions be emailed to me?
Yes, I've just processed it. You should receive an email with the prepaid shipping label and return instructions within the next 10 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
